name: Blog Master List
body:
> Tracker · 2026-07-21

# Summary
One-sheet workbook ("All Company Blogs", 36 rows, file dated 2026-07-21) listing the July and August 2026 blog clusters for all four clients. Each cluster is one pillar plus four supporting posts, with title, focus keyword, slug or URL and status. It is a mid-July snapshot; later progress lives in each client's own blog trackers.

# Clusters and status
| Client | Month | Cluster | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pipeliners | July | Monsoon | Pillar live (refreshed 7/20) plus 4 supporting posts live |
| Summit Plumbing Pros | July | Monsoon | Pillar live (per file), 4 supporting drafted |
| Summit Plumbing Pros | August | Drain Cleaning | All 5 planned |
| Prestige Plumbing | July | Drain | Pillar "Drain Cleaning vs. Hydro Jetting" live (slug TBD), 4 supporting drafted |
| Prestige Plumbing | August | Hidden Leak | All 5 planned |
| Alphalete Trenchless | July | Monsoon | All 5 planned |
| Alphalete Trenchless | August | Hydro Jetting | All 5 planned |

# Pillars and focus keywords
- Pipeliners: "Monsoon Season Pipe Problems" (why does my sewer back up when it rains); supporting: bellied sewer pipe, hydro jetting vs snaking, commercial sewer backup, sewer backup what to do.
- Summit July: "Monsoon Season and Your Plumbing" (monsoon plumbing / sewer backup); supporting: gurgling drains when it rains, clog vs sewer line problem, tree roots in sewer line, sewage backup what to do.
- Summit August: "Why Your Drain Smells or Backs Up in Summer"; supporting: why does my drain smell, signs you need drain cleaning, are chemical drain cleaners bad, how often drain cleaning.
- Prestige July: drain cleaning / hydro jetting; supporting: what not to put down the drain, drain smells like sewage, are chemical drain cleaners bad, main sewer line clog signs.
- Prestige August: "Signs You Have a Hidden Water Leak" (signs of a hidden water leak); supporting: slab leak signs, toilet leak / high bill, check water meter for leak, summer water bill spike / irrigation leak.
- Alphalete July: "Why Does My Sewer Back Up When It Rains?"; supporting: expansive soil sewer line damage, sewage backup what to do, sewer smell in yard, hydro jetting tree roots.
- Alphalete August: "Hydro Jetting vs. Snaking"; supporting: why does my drain keep clogging, is hydro jetting safe for old pipes, hydro jetting grease, commercial hydro jetting.

# Notes
- Several focus keywords repeat across clients (for example "why does my sewer back up when it rains", "sewage backup what to do", "are chemical drain cleaners bad", "hydro jetting vs snaking"). That is fine across different sites, but each must stay unique within its own site per [SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards).
- Pipeliners rows use "Pipeliners USA" as the company label; blog copy must say "Pipeliners".
